title: NAV IR 2 FAULT

actions.say: Attitude and heading switching, first officer side, select to the number 3 inertial reference.
actions.ack: First officer attitude and heading on inertial reference 3.

actions.say: Cross-check attitude, heading, and navigation against the standby instruments and the opposite side.
Expect a possible loss of one autopilot and flight director; select the remaining side.

status: Status. Inertial reference 2 lost; the first officer is displaying inertial reference 3.
Autopilot 2 may be unavailable; use autopilot 1.
Navigation accuracy is preserved on the remaining inertial references; monitor for any drift.
